requiredFindings.title: ACTIVE still reconfirms the original registry capture
requiredFindings.failureScenario: RESERVED is confirmed, so project-registry.v2 is R1. The replacement primitive's step 1 still reconfirms item 5's full sample, which is R0, and ACTIVE stops there. If the R1 predecessor paragraph is followed instead, item 7 still takes N from the ACTIVE row in item 5's capture. A FirstUseCandidate's R0 has no ACTIVE row, so the published R2 grants no lease.

requiredFindings.title: The layout proof is not Git's effective configuration
requiredFindings.failureScenario: The local config is an ordinary version-0 file with no canonical core.worktree key, and either that file sets Worktree in a different case, an Include section in a different case supplies it, or ~/.gitconfig sets core.worktree. Git honors the effective key. The index tracks .opensip/project-id.v1 relative to the relocated worktree. The path computed from the .git parent does not match, the marker is reported untracked, and registration or the lease proceeds.

requiredFindings.title: Index versions 3 and 4 do not identify the path bytes
requiredFindings.failureScenario: The index is version 4 with 20-byte hashes and no split-index or sparse-directory extension. The marker path is prefix-compressed. A scan that accepts version 4 and reads version-2 path bytes finds no match, reports the marker untracked, and registration or the lease proceeds.

scope: Law X2 r3. Codex RF-1 and RF-3 are closed. RF-2 and RF-4 are not: the numbered registry steps still reconfirm R0, and the Git layout proof is neither the effective config nor the v3/v4 path layout. No product cargo.
